prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your crash, the injuries, the insurance/defendant situation, and what you want (quick settlement vs. trial-ready counsel). That said, Chicago has many highly regarded personal-injury firms with strong car-accident practices. How to pick one and some names to consider:

What to look for
- Relevant experience with car-accident cases (serious injury, wrongful death, complex liability, uninsured/underinsured motorist claims).  
- Trial experience and a record of significant settlements/verdicts (not just quick, low-value settlements).  
- Good client reviews and peer ratings (Avvo, Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell).  
- Clear contingency fee terms and how costs are handled.  
- Willingness to coordinate medical care and handle medical liens.  
- Good communication and a team that can move your case if you’re awaiting treatment.  
- Free consultation and willingness to explain strategy and realistic value.

Well-known Chicago personal injury firms (examples to research)
- Clifford Law Offices  
- Corboy & Demetrio  
- Levin & Perconti  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard  
- Power Rogers (Power Rogers & Smith/Power Rogers)  
- Goldberg Weisman Cairo

(These are examples of reputable firms in Chicago — check each firm’s recent results, client reviews, and whether a particular attorney in the firm handles cases like yours.)

Questions to ask during a consultation
- How many car-accident cases like mine have you handled? Outcomes?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (attorney vs. paralegal)?  
- What is your fee (percentage) and what costs will I pay?  
- Do you try cases or primarily settle?  
- How long do you expect my case to take?  
- Can you provide references from recent clients?

If you’d like, tell me:
- the zip code where the crash happened,  
- whether you were injured and how seriously, and  
- whether the other driver’s insurance is cooperating —  
and I’ll assemble a short, tailored list of attorneys/law firms in your area with links to profiles and recent results.
